title: Companion sources fetched under work/companions: simulator packages whose stop lives in a companion at another version
description: Reviewed companion sources (user decision of 2026-11-05: a stop may cite a locally cloned companion repository at a pinned commit; the user's authorisation of 2026-11-05: shallow clones of the companion versions the version-mismatch packages need, each at one commit, under work/companions with LOCK.json). Each entry restates the card's current decision and adds companions; an entry with lock names the LOCK.json alias of its clone (commit, profile, path and needed_by checked by build_registry.py, validate.py and gate G1), the others are corpus companions as in companion-sources.json. Records: MHS/changes/COMPANION-LOCKS.md and MHS/changes/COMPANION-TOPIC-READBACK.md.

overrides.justification: Repair 2026-11-05: the stop is the Melodic lock companions' pause_physics, confirmed by get_physics_properties pause true (reviewed needed_by widening; no network).

companions.reason: pause_physics and its get_physics_properties read-back (pause) are served by gazebo_ros 2.8.7 (Melodic), whose empty_world.launch the clone's lab_world.launch includes.
World::Step (Gazebo 9.19.0) advances simulation time and calls Update only when the world is not paused, a step is pending or a reset is due; facts only.

overrides.justification: Re-author of agilexrobotics/ugv_gazebo_sim (2026-11-05): the stop is the gazebo_ros world pause, fetched under work/companions at the Melodic pins already used for panda_simulation. Scout V2 only. No unpause.
